launches.title: Rastro AI: launch products faster
launches.tagline: The fastest way for retailers and distributors to launch new product lines
launches.body:
I used to be an AI lead on Shopify’s catalog. We worked with everything from sex toys (real story) to lightbulbs, for 2bn products. Chaotic catalogs, and lots of war stories.

Since then, we heard the same problem from large catalog merchants like Sunco. Vendors send them Excel sheets with 30% missing data, inconsistent product identifiers and blurry images.

Our catalog agent lives for these headaches. Share any vendor data, pull competitor pricing and product specs, generate images, standardize attributes and output products at scale.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95204&key=user_uploads/1651987/c9dffef9-b2c2-4762-a90f-fdce9c5a2b63)

The result? A customer told us “[Rastro.AI](http://Rastro.AI) gave us a new scale”. We get thousands of products out of their backlog, and quality listings online.

**Ask**: do you know any retailers or distributors with 5k+ products? We’ll help them launch their next product line in the first month, or offer a refund. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95204&key=user_uploads/1651987/f45b9b48-912f-44a4-bb47-f80019f8a058)

launches.title: Rastro: Your personal interior designer
launches.tagline: Find beautiful objects for your home, at no extra cost.
launches.body:
# Should it cost you 50k to decorate your home?

Decorating your home? You have 2 choices: hire an interior designer for $50k, or spend 50 hours doing it yourself. A beautiful home, time, money: pick two.

Rastro is your hassle-free personal shopper and interior designer:

1. We craft your taste profile in a 15-minute call.
2. We find you matching decor from 46 sources.
3. We buy what you love, delivered to your door.

Are you decorating your space? \
[**Book your 15-minute onboarding call here.**](https://forms.fillout.com/t/eJHrqtsGiKus)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83240&key=user_uploads/2075162/4c6ff5d7-be50-45e6-9245-51b6f184a78c)

# 💡 How we got here

In our first week at YC, we built a tool to help interior designers source furniture for less. Early on, a designer told us, “Getting an $8k chair for $4k isn’t material, we do $75k jobs.” Not sure their customer would agree, but it does explain their fee.

Most of us know our taste, but scrolling dozens of websites is a waste of time. Niche sourcing channels are jealously guarded by professional dealers, and the best inventory is difficult to find.

# ✅ Rastro’s Solution

Rastro is your personal interior designer, with no up-front costs.

1. In an onboarding call, we craft a taste profile for you. Show us your space and tell us what you’re looking for. Share specific pieces you love, styles that inspire you, and how your home is laid out.
2. Our sourcing agents automatically scour through 46 different sites to find decor matching your tastes. We look through auctions and listing sites as well as classic sources like 1stDibs or West Elm. You receive our top picks and share your feedback directly on Rastro.
3. We deliver everything you purchase to your door, leveraging retailer partnerships and referrals to ensure a same-price guarantee.

Let us help you decorate your home: book your onboarding call today at [**rastro.sh**](https://rastro.sh)
